events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's an anthem. John Lennon's 'Imagine' album dropped this day in 1971, and its message still resonates today.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: English musician and songwriter Sting celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, a true icon of British music.

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: The first generation Apple iPod, revolutionising portable music, was released on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before? 25 years ago today, Apple unleashed the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. What was your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the world's most famous secret agent and the iconic films that have thrilled us for decades.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born in 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born in 1939, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, widely known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: An absolute masterpiece. The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today, packed with classics and surprises.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who was born in 1946 and would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Gone but never forgotten. Today we remember the incredible Freddie Mercury, a voice and stage presence truly unmatched, who would have turned 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived 61 years ago today, showcasing their evolving sound and lyrical depth.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was born in 1940 and would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember the immense legacy of John Lennon, a voice for peace and a musical genius, tragically taken 46 years ago.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic musician and cultural chameleon David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering David Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie, a true innovator and legend, would have turned 80 today. His influence remains as strong as ever.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets the world moving. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! A true architect of rock and roll sound with Led Zeppelin.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Raise a glass! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart, a rock and roll legend with a career spanning decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: One step beyond! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the frontman of Madness, bringing us classics for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, born in 1956, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His soulful voice gave us some unforgettable tunes from the 80s and beyond.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer, songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: What a woman! Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton, an icon of music, philanthropy, and pure sparkle.
